name: DataForSEO Connector
description: Keyword rankings, search volume, related keyword research, and backlink data via your own DataForSEO account -- SERP positions with history, Google Ads search volume/CPC, DataForSEO Labs related-keyword ideas, and domain backlink summaries. Organize tracking into projects (your own sites or a competitor's), with a permanent Sandbox/Live toggle so you can try everything free before spending real API credits.

tools.name: connect_dataforseo
tools.description: Connect DataForSEO by saving your API login+password, after checking they actually work. Get them from your DataForSEO dashboard -- the API password is separate from your dashboard login password.

login.description: DataForSEO API login (from your DataForSEO dashboard, usually your account email)
login.title: Login

password.description: DataForSEO API password (from your DataForSEO dashboard -- a separate password from your dashboard login)
password.title: Password

tools.name: disconnect_dataforseo
tools.description: Disconnect DataForSEO: deletes the saved login+password. Existing projects, tracked keywords/domains and their history are kept -- only new checks are blocked until you connect again.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: get_dataforseo_connection
tools.description: Check whether DataForSEO is connected (does not reveal the credentials).

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: set_sandbox_mode
tools.description: Switch between DataForSEO's free Sandbox (test data, no charges) and Live (real data, real cost) mode. This is a standing setting -- it stays on Sandbox or Live for every check until changed again.

sandbox.description: True = use DataForSEO's free Sandbox (test data, no charges). False = Live (real data, real cost).
sandbox.title: Sandbox

tools.name: get_sandbox_mode
tools.description: Check whether DataForSEO Connector is currently in Sandbox or Live mode.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new DataForSEO tracking project for a domain -- your own site or a competitor's (set is_own_site=false). Sets the default location/language used for keyword checks in this project unless overridden per keyword. Use list_connected_sites first if you want to add a site you already connected in WordPress Hub with one click instead.

default_location_name.description: Default DataForSEO location name for SERP/keyword lookups, e.g. 'Chisinau,Moldova' or 'London,England,United Kingdom'
default_location_name.title: Default Location Name

is_own_site.description: False if this project tracks a competitor's domain, not your own
is_own_site.title: Is Own Site

return_schema.description: One tracked domain/project in DataForSEO Connector.
return_schema.title: DFSProject

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all DataForSEO tracking projects (your own sites and any competitor domains you chose to track).

DFSProject.description: One tracked domain/project in DataForSEO Connector.
DFSProject.title: DFSProject

tools.name: list_connected_sites
tools.description: List sites already connected in other apps (WordPress Hub today) that Quick Add offers as one-click DataForSEO project candidates, flagging which are already registered here.

ConnectedSite.description:
One site read from a site-provider extension -- the raw material
behind the Quick Add list.
ConnectedSite.title: ConnectedSite

tools.name: track_keyword
tools.description: Start tracking a keyword's Google SERP position for a project. Uses the project's default location/language unless overridden here. Does not check the ranking yet -- call check_serp_ranking after.

location_name.description: Override the project's default location name; empty = use project default
location_name.title: Location Name

language_code.description: Override the project's default language code; empty = use project default
language_code.title: Language Code

return_schema.description: One keyword being tracked for SERP position within a project.
return_schema.title: TrackedKeyword

tools.name: list_tracked_keywords
tools.description: List tracked keywords, optionally filtered by project, with each keyword's latest known SERP position.

project_id.description: Filter by project. Empty = all projects.
project_id.title: Project Id

TrackedKeyword.description: One keyword being tracked for SERP position within a project.
TrackedKeyword.title: TrackedKeyword

tools.name: untrack_keyword
tools.description: Stop tracking a keyword. Its recorded history snapshots are kept.

return_schema.description:
Result of untrack_keyword/untrack_domain -- confirms the id removed
from active tracking; history snapshots are kept.
return_schema.title: UntrackResult

tools.name: check_serp_ranking
tools.description: Run a fresh Google SERP check for a tracked keyword: finds the project's own domain among the results and records a new history snapshot, plus shows the top competing results.

keyword_id.description: Tracked keyword id from list_tracked_keywords -- runs a fresh SERP check and records a new history snapshot
keyword_id.title: Keyword Id

depth.description: How many top organic results to scan for the project's domain (1-100)
depth.title: Depth

SerpCompetitorItem.description: One competing organic result shown alongside our own ranking.
SerpCompetitorItem.title: SerpCompetitorItem

return_schema.description: Result of a fresh SERP check for one tracked keyword.
return_schema.title: SerpCheckResult

tools.name: get_keyword_history
tools.description: Read the position history for a tracked keyword -- every past SERP check, most recent first.

limit.description: Max snapshots to return, most recent first (1-200)
limit.title: Limit

KeywordSnapshot.description: One historical SERP-position reading for a tracked keyword.
KeywordSnapshot.title: KeywordSnapshot

tools.name: get_keyword_volume
tools.description: Look up monthly Google Ads search volume, CPC, and competition for up to 1000 keywords at once. Optionally pass a project_id to use its default location/language.

project_id.description: Optional project id -- supplies default location/language when set
project_id.title: Project Id

keywords.description: Up to 1000 keyword phrases to look up search volume/CPC/competition for
keywords.title: Keywords

location_name.description: Override location name; empty = use project default or 'Chisinau,Moldova'
location_name.title: Location Name

language_code.description: Override two-letter language code; empty = use project default or 'ru'
language_code.title: Language Code

tools.name: find_related_keywords
tools.description: Discover related keyword ideas for a seed keyword -- the 'searches related to' SERP graph, with search volume and CPC per idea. Great for finding new keywords worth tracking.

project_id.description: Optional project id -- supplies default location/language when set
project_id.title: Project Id

location_name.description: Override location name; empty = use project default or 'Chisinau,Moldova'
location_name.title: Location Name

language_code.description: Override two-letter language code; empty = use project default or 'ru'
language_code.title: Language Code

depth.description: Search-graph depth to explore (1-4) -- higher finds more but costs more
depth.title: Depth

tools.name: track_domain
tools.description: Start tracking a domain's backlink profile for a project (your own site or a competitor's). Does not fetch data yet -- call get_backlink_profile after.

domain.description: Domain to monitor for backlinks, e.g. 'climtec.md' or a competitor's domain
domain.title: Domain

return_schema.description:
One domain being monitored for backlink profile within a project.
Usually the project's own domain, but can also be a competitor's.
return_schema.title: TrackedDomain

tools.name: list_tracked_domains
tools.description: List tracked domains, optionally filtered by project.

project_id.description: Filter by project. Empty = all projects.
project_id.title: Project Id

TrackedDomain.description:
One domain being monitored for backlink profile within a project.
Usually the project's own domain, but can also be a competitor's.
TrackedDomain.title: TrackedDomain

tools.name: untrack_domain
tools.description: Stop tracking a domain. Its recorded history snapshots are kept.

return_schema.description:
Result of untrack_keyword/untrack_domain -- confirms the id removed
from active tracking; history snapshots are kept.
return_schema.title: UntrackResult

tools.name: get_backlink_profile
tools.description: Run a fresh backlink summary check for a tracked domain: total backlinks, referring domains, and DataForSEO's domain rank, and records a new history snapshot.

domain_id.description: Tracked domain id from list_tracked_domains -- runs a fresh backlink check and records a new history snapshot
domain_id.title: Domain Id

return_schema.description: One historical backlink-profile reading for a tracked domain.
return_schema.title: BacklinkSnapshot

tools.name: get_domain_history
tools.description: Read the backlink history for a tracked domain -- every past check, most recent first.

limit.description: Max snapshots to return, most recent first (1-200)
limit.title: Limit

BacklinkSnapshot.description: One historical backlink-profile reading for a tracked domain.
BacklinkSnapshot.title: BacklinkSnapshot

secrets.name: dataforseo_login
secrets.description: DataForSEO API login (usually your account email) -- from your DataForSEO dashboard, NOT your dashboard login password.

secrets.name: dataforseo_password
secrets.description: DataForSEO API password -- a separate password from your dashboard login, shown once when the API password is generated/reset in your DataForSEO dashboard.
